title: verbena platensis f. iverana
intro: Verbena platensis f. iverana, commonly known as Verbena Iverana, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Verbenaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic actions, which can help in treating various ailments like anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Verbena Iverana include sedative and calming effects, making it a potential treatment for stress and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
